name: Advanced Feedback and Control
description: Extends feedback control theory and applications (from 30.101 Systems & Control) to include multi-input multi-output and discrete-time systems. Covers mathematical modeling and analysis of discrete time systems using state-space, pulse transfer function and z-transform. Relates controllability and observability and their canonical forms to synthesize and design advanced continuous and discrete-time controllers, including pole-placement based controller design and formulation of state observers.
